pagerduty-bot: AUTOPAGE fired: service=svc-infer release=v3.8.2-canary region=eu-central-1 -> sustained 5xx spike (error rate +78% over baseline) and p95 latency +420ms. Auto-escalation path: primary oncall -> secondary. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/canary-5xx. Please ack.
Alex Chen: Acked (pagerduty). I'm on it, joining the thread. Grabbing logs and console now. @Dana (sre-lead) can you stand by?
Dana (sre-lead): On way. Which canary cluster? staging-canary-3 in eu-central-1? Any initial hypothesis?
pagerduty-bot: Alerts show gateway 502 / 504 originating at model-proxy (svc-proxy-*) with upstream resets to quant-node-02. Observed connection resets + increased retry loops. Example tracing span: model-proxy -> quant-worker connection reset. Sending relevant logs.
SRE-Oncall: Dumping pod logs for quant-worker-02, paste below.
SRE-Oncall: ```
kubectl -n canary logs quant-worker-02 --tail=200
2026-03-15T03:12:22Z ERROR connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T03:12:22Z WARN retrying request (attempt 3)
2026-03-15T03:12:24Z ERROR OOMKilled: process killed, memory overcommit
```
Alex Chen: I see OOMKilled lines. Looks like memory pressure on quant-node-02. I'm going to pause the rollout and divert traffic off canary.
Megan (releases): Confirm pause request initiated.
Megan (releases): `releasesctl rollout pause --id rollout-20260315-83` -> acknowledged by control plane.
Megan (releases): Also applying traffic shift: `trafficctl shift --service svc-infer --from canary --to stable --percent 100 --region eu-central-1` — doing now.
Customer Ops: Notifying impacted customers in eu-central-1 (small subset reporting 502s). Giving a heads-up: likely transient, will send update when rollback complete.
Dana (sre-lead): Noted: KV cache growth on quant-node-02 before OOM. Could be a memory leak under the new quant kernel. Setting a temporary connection limit on model-proxy to reduce simultaneous streams.
Emily (observability): Putting a temporary circuit-breaker and disabling aggressive retries to reduce amplification. Adding alert suppression for noisy downstream errors to avoid paging churn.
Chris K: I'm taking lead for the rollback/mitigation steps while Alex finishes telemetry checks.
Chris K: Rolling back canary image to v3.8.1 stable now.
Chris K: ```
kubectl -n canary set image deploy/svc-infer svc-infer=redwood/svc-infer:v3.8.1-canary-rollback
kubectl -n canary rollout status deploy/svc-infer
```
SRE-Oncall: Watch shows pods terminating and recreating with v3.8.1. Observed 5xx rate falling within first 30s of rollout completion.
Alex Chen: Confirmed 5xx down to baseline (~2% from 18%). P95 latency back to expected. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: AUTOPAGE escalation status: initial page -> ack by Alex Chen at 4851234572; escalated to Dana at 4851234578 (auto) then acknowledged by Chris K at 4851234585. PD incident now marked as acknowledged and mitigation in progress.
Customer Ops: Sent update to affected customers: we're rolling back the canary and diverting traffic; monitoring closely. No broader outage. Customers asked to open tickets if they still see errors.
Emily (observability): Metrics stabilization ongoing. I'm holding a 10min watch window for p95 and 5xx. Also capturing metric snapshots for postmortem.
Dana (sre-lead): Leaving notes: suspected memory regression in quant kernel under high batch concurrency. Pinning to v3.8.1 for now. Will open bug against quant runtime for deeper triage.
Alex Chen: Good work team. I'll close the PD incident once Chris confirms stable for 10m and customer ops has notified stakeholders. Please add any discovery to the incident tracker and I'll start the postmortem draft.
Chris K: Service stable for 7m, 5xx at baseline. Continuing to monitor for the 10m window.
pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by Chris K at 4851234605. Auto-page closed. Please file postmortem and link to thread.
Customer Ops: Thanks all — will follow up with customers with final note after postmortem.
Alex Chen: Filing postmortem link: https://redwood/pm/INC-4851234567-postmortem. Tagging @release-team @sre for followup actions.
Dana (sre-lead): Action items: 1) revert quant kernel change in canary pipeline, 2) add memory regression test to CI, 3) investigate KV cache retention and fix leak. Assigning owners in postmortem.
SRE-Oncall: Adding logs/artifacts to incident ticket. Closing out channel thread. :white_check_mark:
